description: This file contains functions for handling touch pointer events, scaling display coordinates, and sending touch event updates in a WebRTC HTML client context.

methods.name: trackPointerEvents
methods.description: Sets up event listeners for pointer events on a given element and updates the server with touch data.

methods.name: scaleDisplayCoordinates
methods.description: Calculates scaled display coordinates based on the device's video width and element width.

methods.name: makeScaleTouchpadCoordinates
methods.description: Returns a function to scale touchpad coordinates based on its resolution and element width.

methods.name: sendEventUpdate
methods.description: Prepares and sends multi-touch event data to the server via the provided data channel.
